meta.title: InvoiceLead, quotes, QR-bills and Swiss accounting
meta.description: Quotes, compliant QR-bills, automatic payment reminders and double-entry accounting for Swiss freelancers and SMEs. Free to start.

home.title: Quotes, invoices and accounting, done before the end of the day.
home.subtitle: InvoiceLead prepares your quotes, issues compliant QR-bills, chases unpaid invoices and keeps your Swiss accounts. For freelancers and SMEs alike, free to start.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to get paid, and nothing more

quotes.title: From quote to invoice in one click
quotes.body: An accepted quote becomes an order confirmation, then an invoice, with nothing to re-enter.

qr.title: QR-bills to the Swiss standard
qr.body: Payment part compliant with the SIX standard, structured addresses, QR or SCOR reference.

reminders.title: Automatic payment reminders
reminders.body: Three reminder levels, with fees and deadlines you set, sent at the right time.

accounting.title: Double-entry accounting
accounting.body: SME chart of accounts, entries created from your invoices and payments, balance sheet and income statement.

vat.title: Swiss VAT under control
vat.body: Rates of 8.1%, 2.6% and 3.8%, effective method or net tax rate method, VAT return prepared.

team.title: The whole team, and your fiduciary
team.body: Several users per company, with a single account for all Lead apps.

home.familyTitle: One account, all your Lead apps
home.familyBody: Scanlead captures your trade fair contacts, CRMlead follows them through to the sale, InvoiceLead invoices and collects payment. A single Lead account to move from one to the other.

items.a: Yes. The payment part follows the current SIX standard (version 2.3, structured addresses), with a QR or SCOR reference depending on your bank account.

items.q: Can I keep all my accounts in InvoiceLead?
items.a: That is the goal: double-entry accounting on the SME chart of accounts, entries created from your invoices and payments, balance sheet, income statement and VAT return. These features are being rolled out gradually.
The effective method and the net tax rate method, on agreed or received consideration. The VAT return will be exported in the eCH-0217 XML format, accepted by the SFTA portal.
The single account for the Lead family: the same login for InvoiceLead, Scanlead and CRMlead, and a plan paid for in one app unlocks the others.

items.q: Can my accountant access my accounts?
items.a: Yes, free fiduciary access is provided from the Pro plan upwards.
In the United States (Vercel and Neon, Ohio), encrypted in transit and at rest. Details are in the privacy policy.

items.q: Can I get my data back?
items.a: Yes, at any time, and for 30 days after cancellation. Your books must be kept for ten years: the export is designed for that.

items.q: Do I need a payment card to start?
items.a: No. The Free plan requires no card and has no time limit.
